approach: Iterate through the string from left to right while keeping track of the current harmonic substring length.
observation: A character S[i] continues the harmonic pattern from S[i-1] if S[i] == S[i-1] or S[i] - S[i-1] == 1.
bruteForce: Check all possible substrings for validity in O(N^2) time.
optimalSolution: Single pass iteration. Increment current streak if valid, otherwise reset streak to 1. Track max streak length.
dryRun: S = 'abcabc'. i=1('b'): diff=1 -> len=2. i=2('c'): diff=1 -> len=3. i=3('a'): diff=-2 -> len=4 ('abca'). i=4('b'): diff=1 -> len=5 ('abcab'). i=5('c'): diff=1 -> len=1. Max = 5.
